facts.claim: Celebrity Xcel (Celebrity Cruises): Entered service 2025; 141,420 GT; 3260 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 323 m length; Edge class.
We Didn’t Find your Happy Place, We Built It. Explore Celebrity Xcel things to do, deck plans, rooms and itineraries.
Celebrity Xcel is the fifth Edge-class cruise ship built by Celebrity Cruises.
She is sister ship of Celebrity Edge, Celebrity Apex, Celebrity Beyond, and Celebrity Ascent.

catalogSpecs.description: Edge-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2025; 141,420 GT; approx. 3,260 guests at double occupancy.
